_comment: break: 0 is deliberate: the nightly mutation job treats a score as a report to look at, never a gate. Added 2026-09-20 to close the 'only 2 of 8 src projects have mutation coverage' gap (docs/handoffs/2026-09-20-coverage-mutation-gaps-from-jaunty-probe.md). `mutate` is narrowed on purpose here, unlike Analysis/SqlParser's configs: Generator is 13,025 LOC, the largest project in the solution, and most of it (CodeEmitter.Part*.cs, JauntyQGenerator.Part*.cs) is source-emission templating -- high LOC, comparatively low branching complexity. Scoped instead to the validation/diagnostic logic (QueryValidator*, the *Analyzer files, JauntyDiagnostics, IdentifierGuard), which is where wrong output would actually be a correctness bug rather than a cosmetic emission difference. Revisit if CodeEmitter/JauntyQGenerator logic turns out to need mutation coverage too -- this is a first cut, not a final answer.
